story: Late in 207 BCE Liu Bang entered the Guanzhong region first and accepted the surrender of Qin at Xianyang. The rebel leaders had promised that whoever got there first would be king of the area. Xiang Yu, arriving later with about 400,000 men against Liu Bang's 100,000, was furious. His adviser Fan Zeng urged him to destroy Liu Bang.

Xiang Yu's uncle Xiang Bo, a friend of Liu Bang's adviser Zhang Liang, warned them. Liu Bang came to Xiang Yu's camp at Hongmen to apologize. At the feast, Fan Zeng had Xiang Zhuang perform a sword dance, hoping to kill Liu Bang, but Xiang Bo danced too and shielded him. Liu Bang's bodyguard Fan Kuai burst in and spoke boldly. Then Liu Bang excused himself to go to the toilet and slipped away.
Xiang Yu then burned Xianyang and gave Liu Bang the remote land of Hanzhong.
story_zh: 前207年末，刘邦率先进入关中，在咸阳接受秦朝投降。各路起义军曾约定，先入关中者为王。后到的项羽拥兵约四十万，而刘邦只有十万，项羽大为恼怒。谋士范增劝他趁机消灭刘邦。
项羽的叔父项伯与刘邦的谋士张良是好友，连夜前去报信。刘邦第二天亲自到鸿门向项羽赔罪。宴席上，范增让项庄舞剑助兴，伺机刺杀刘邦，项伯也拔剑起舞，用身体护住刘邦。刘邦的卫士樊哙闯进帐中，慷慨陈词。随后刘邦借口上厕所，悄悄逃回本营。
此后项羽火烧咸阳，把偏远的汉中封给了刘邦。
hongmen.why: By letting Liu Bang live, Xiang Yu lost his best chance to remove the rival who would defeat him four years later.
hongmen.why_zh: 项羽放走刘邦，错失了除掉对手的最好时机，四年后反被刘邦所灭。

quote.zh: 如今人方为刀俎，我为鱼肉，何辞为？
quote.en: Right now they are the knife and the chopping board, and we are the fish and the meat. Why bother taking leave?
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: From 206 BCE Xiang Yu and Liu Bang fought for control of China. Xiang Yu won most of the battles, but Liu Bang held the rich Guanzhong region, which Xiao He kept supplied, while his general Han Xin conquered the north and east. In 203 BCE the two sides agreed to split the country, but Liu Bang broke the truce and attacked.

In 202 BCE the armies of Han Xin, Peng Yue and Ying Bu closed in on Xiang Yu at Gaixia. At night the trapped Chu soldiers heard songs of Chu from all around them, and thought their homeland had fallen. Xiang Yu sang a farewell to his consort Yu.
He broke out with 800 horsemen and fought his way south to the Wu River. Refusing to cross and face his people in defeat, he killed himself. Liu Bang took the title of emperor that year.
story_zh: 从前206年起，项羽与刘邦争夺天下。项羽打赢了大多数战役，但刘邦据有富庶的关中，萧何源源不断地供应兵员粮草，大将韩信又平定了北方和东方。前203年，双方约定以鸿沟为界平分天下，刘邦随即毁约追击。
前202年，韩信、彭越、英布三路大军把项羽围困在垓下。夜里，被围的楚军听到四面八方都唱着楚地的歌，以为楚地已被汉军占领，军心瓦解，这就是“四面楚歌”。项羽对着爱姬虞姬悲歌诀别。
他率八百骑兵突围，一路血战南下到乌江边，自觉无颜见江东父老，拒绝渡江，拔剑自刎。同年，刘邦即皇帝位。
gaixia.why: Gaixia ended the Chu–Han war and founded the Han dynasty, which ruled for four centuries.
gaixia.why_zh: 垓下之战结束了楚汉相争，开启了延续四百年的汉朝。

people.name: Liu Bang
people.role: King of Han, then Emperor Gaozu

quote.zh: 力拔山兮气盖世，时不利兮骓不逝。
quote.en: My strength could pull up mountains, my spirit covered the world; but the times are against me, and my horse Zhui will not go on.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: While China was at war, Modu Chanyu had united the Xiongnu into a powerful steppe empire. In 201 BCE the Han vassal king Xin at Mayi went over to the Xiongnu. In the winter of 200 BCE Liu Bang led a large army north. Many soldiers lost fingers to frostbite.

Seeing the Xiongnu retreat, Liu Bang hurried ahead with his vanguard to Pingcheng, near modern Datong. Modu's cavalry surrounded him on Baideng hill for seven days. His adviser Chen Ping is said to have sent rich gifts to Modu's consort, who persuaded Modu to open a gap, and Liu Bang escaped.
Han could not beat the Xiongnu. On Liu Jing's advice, it adopted heqin: a Han princess was married to the chanyu, and Han sent yearly gifts of silk, wine and grain in exchange for peace.
story_zh: 中原战乱之际，冒顿单于统一匈奴各部，建立起强大的草原帝国。前201年，镇守马邑的韩王信投降匈奴。前200年冬，刘邦亲率大军北征，许多士兵冻掉了手指。
见匈奴后撤，刘邦率前锋急追到平城（今大同附近），被冒顿的骑兵围困在白登山上七天七夜。据说谋士陈平派人给冒顿的阏氏送去厚礼，阏氏劝冒顿网开一面，刘邦才得以脱身。
汉朝无力战胜匈奴，于是采纳刘敬的建议，实行“和亲”：把汉朝公主嫁给单于，每年送去丝绸、酒和粮食，以换取和平。
baideng.why: Heqin kept an uneasy peace with the Xiongnu for about sixty years, until Emperor Wu chose war.
baideng.why_zh: 和亲政策让汉匈之间维持了约六十年的不稳定和平，直到汉武帝改为武力反击。

story: Emperor Wu learned that the Yuezhi people had been driven west by the Xiongnu and hated them. Around 138 BCE he sent Zhang Qian, with about a hundred men and a Xiongnu guide named Ganfu, to find the Yuezhi and form an alliance.

Crossing Xiongnu land, Zhang Qian was captured and held for about ten years. He married and had a son, but kept his envoy's staff. He finally escaped and travelled through Dayuan (Ferghana) and Kangju to the Yuezhi, now settled near Bactria. They had no wish to fight. On the way back he was captured again, and escaped during a Xiongnu power struggle. In 126 BCE he reached Chang'an with only Ganfu.
His report described the horses of Ferghana, Parthia and India, and Chinese cloth he had seen for sale in Bactria.
story_zh: 汉武帝得知月氏人被匈奴赶到西方，对匈奴怀有深仇，便在约前138年派张骞带着一百多人和匈奴向导堂邑父，去寻找月氏，联合夹击匈奴。
张骞途经匈奴地界时被俘，扣留了约十年，在那里娶妻生子，却始终保存着汉朝使节的符节。他终于逃脱，经大宛（费尔干纳）、康居到达已在大夏附近定居的月氏。月氏人安居乐业，无意复仇。归途中张骞再次被匈奴俘虏，趁匈奴内乱才逃了出来。前126年他回到长安时，身边只剩下堂邑父一人。
他带回的报告介绍了大宛的骏马、安息和身毒（印度），还提到在大夏市场上见到的蜀地布匹。
zhang-qian.why: Zhang Qian's journey gave China its first real knowledge of Central Asia and opened the route that became the Silk Road.
zhang-qian.why_zh: 张骞出使使中国第一次真正了解了中亚，开辟了后来的丝绸之路。

story: After years of war, Emperor Wu decided to strike the Xiongnu in their home territory north of the Gobi. In 119 BCE he sent two armies, each of 50,000 cavalry, with many more infantry carrying supplies. Wei Qing led one and his nephew Huo Qubing the other.

Wei Qing met the chanyu Yizhixie himself. He formed his armoured wagons into a ring and sent cavalry out to fight. As evening fell and a sandstorm rose, he surrounded the Xiongnu, and the chanyu fled. Huo Qubing marched about 2,000 li, defeated the Xiongnu Eastern King and held a ceremony on Mount Langjuxu to mark his victory.
The veteran general Li Guang lost his way in the desert and killed himself. Han lost most of its war horses, but the Xiongnu court moved far north.
story_zh: 经过多年交战，汉武帝决定深入匈奴腹地，到大漠以北决战。前119年，他派出两路大军，各有五万骑兵，另有大批步兵运送辎重。一路由卫青率领，一路由他的外甥霍去病率领。
卫青与伊稚斜单于主力遭遇，他用武刚车环绕成营，再派骑兵出击。傍晚时分狂风大作，沙石扑面，汉军趁势包抄，单于突围逃走。霍去病北进两千余里，大败匈奴左贤王，在狼居胥山举行祭天仪式，这就是“封狼居胥”。
老将李广在沙漠中迷路，被追究责任，愤而自杀。汉军战马损失大半，但匈奴王庭从此远遁漠北。
mobei.why: Mobei broke the Xiongnu threat to the Han heartland for a generation, making expansion into the Western Regions possible.
mobei.why_zh: 漠北之战使匈奴在一代人的时间里无力威胁汉朝腹地，为汉朝经营西域创造了条件。

story: Nanyue was founded in 204 BCE by Zhao Tuo, a Qin general left in the far south. From his capital at Panyu (Guangzhou) he ruled the local Yue peoples and sometimes called himself emperor. His descendants accepted Han overlordship in name.

By 113 BCE the young king Zhao Xing and his Chinese mother, the Queen Dowager Jiu, wanted to join the Han empire fully. The powerful chancellor Lü Jia, who had served three kings, opposed this. In 112 BCE he killed the king, the queen dowager and the Han envoys.

Emperor Wu sent armies by land and river under Lu Bode and Yang Pu. In 111 BCE they burned Panyu and captured Lü Jia. Nanyue was divided into nine commanderies, including Jiaozhi and Jiuzhen in what is now northern Vietnam. In 1983 the tomb of the second king was found in Guangzhou.
story_zh: 南越国由留守岭南的秦将赵佗于前204年建立，定都番禺（今广州），统治当地越人，有时还自称皇帝。他的后代在名义上臣服于汉朝。
到前113年，年轻的南越王赵兴和他的汉人母亲樛太后希望正式归附汉朝。历经三朝的权相吕嘉坚决反对，前112年杀死南越王、太后和汉朝使者。
汉武帝派路博德、杨仆等将领水陆并进。前111年汉军火烧番禺，俘获吕嘉。南越故地被分为九郡，其中交趾、九真等郡位于今越南北部。1983年，第二代南越王的陵墓在广州被发现。
nanyue.why: The conquest made the far south, including northern Vietnam, part of China for about a thousand years.
nanyue.why_zh: 此次征服使包括越南北部在内的岭南地区纳入中原王朝版图长达约一千年。

story: Sima Tan, Grand Historian at the Han court, planned a history of the world as the Chinese knew it. Dying in 110 BCE, he made his son Sima Qian promise to finish it. Sima Qian took over his post, read the palace archives and travelled widely.

In 99 BCE he defended the general Li Ling, who had surrendered to the Xiongnu. Emperor Wu was enraged, and Sima Qian was sentenced to death. Unable to pay to escape the sentence, he chose castration instead, so that he could finish the book.

Around 91 BCE the work was complete: 130 chapters covering more than two thousand years. It has basic annals of rulers, tables, treatises on rites, music and economics, chapters on noble houses and many biographies of officials, rebels, merchants and assassins. His lively stories shaped how Chinese people remember their past.
story_zh: 汉朝太史令司马谈打算撰写一部包罗古今的通史。前110年他临终时，嘱咐儿子司马迁一定要完成。司马迁继任太史令，遍读宫中藏书档案，还到各地游历考察。
前99年，他为投降匈奴的将军李陵辩护，触怒汉武帝，被判死刑。他拿不出钱赎罪，为了完成父亲的嘱托，选择接受宫刑，忍辱活了下来。
约前91年，全书完成，共一百三十篇，记述了两千多年的历史。全书分本纪、表、书、世家、列传五部分，除帝王将相外，还为刺客、游侠、商人等各色人物立传。书中生动的故事塑造了中国人对自己历史的记忆。
shiji.why: The Records became the model for all 24 official dynastic histories and a masterpiece of Chinese prose.
shiji.why_zh: 《史记》成为二十四史的开篇和典范，也是中国散文的杰作。

quote.zh: 亦欲以究天人之际，通古今之变，成一家之言。
quote.en: I wished to explore the boundary between heaven and humankind, understand the changes of past and present, and form a school of my own.
quote.from: Letter to Ren An 报任安书

story: After Zhang Qian's journeys and the wars against Dayuan, Han built forts and military farms along the routes into the Tarim Basin. For decades the Xiongnu and Han competed for control of the oasis states there.

In 60 BCE a Xiongnu noble who governed the region, the Rizhu King, surrendered to Han. The officer Zheng Ji, who had led the Han farms at Quli, was made the first Protector General of the Western Regions. His headquarters was at Wulei, near modern Luntai in Xinjiang.

The Protector General watched over both the northern and southern routes around the Taklamakan Desert. He kept peace among the oasis kingdoms, made sure envoys and caravans could travel, and reported to Chang'an. The post lasted until the troubles of Wang Mang's reign.
story_zh: 张骞出使和征伐大宛之后，汉朝沿着进入塔里木盆地的道路修筑城堡、开设屯田。此后几十年间，匈奴与汉朝反复争夺对绿洲诸国的控制权。
前60年，统辖这一地区的匈奴日逐王投降汉朝。曾在渠犁主持屯田的郑吉被任命为首任西域都护，治所设在乌垒城（今新疆轮台附近）。
西域都护同时监护塔克拉玛干沙漠南北两道，调解各绿洲小国之间的纷争，保障使节和商队往来，并向长安报告。这一职位一直延续到王莽时期的动乱。
western-regions.why: The Protectorate brought the Tarim Basin, today's southern Xinjiang, under Chinese administration for the first time.
western-regions.why_zh: 西域都护府的设立，使塔里木盆地（今新疆南部）第一次归入中原王朝的管辖。

story: By the 50s BCE the Xiongnu had split, and Huhanye Chanyu had submitted to Han. In 33 BCE he came to Chang'an for the third time and asked to marry into the Han imperial family.

Emperor Yuan gave him Wang Qiang, known as Zhaojun, a palace lady from Zigui in what is now Hubei. She went north and was given the title Ninghu Yanzhi, meaning 'the consort who brings peace to the Xiongnu'. She bore Huhanye a son. After he died two years later, she followed Xiongnu custom and married his son, the next chanyu, with whom she had two daughters.
To celebrate the match, the emperor changed the era name to Jingning, 'peace on the frontier'. A later legend says a court painter made her portrait ugly because she refused to bribe him.
story_zh: 到公元前一世纪五十年代，匈奴已经分裂，呼韩邪单于归附汉朝。前33年，他第三次来到长安，请求与汉朝皇室联姻。
汉元帝把来自秭归（今属湖北）的宫女王嫱（字昭君）赐给他。昭君远嫁塞北，被封为“宁胡阏氏”，意思是使匈奴安宁的王后。她为呼韩邪生了一个儿子。两年后呼韩邪去世，她按照匈奴习俗嫁给了继位的单于，即呼韩邪的儿子，又生了两个女儿。
为了纪念这次联姻，汉元帝把年号改为“竟宁”，意为边境安宁。后世传说宫廷画师毛延寿因昭君不肯行贿，故意把她画丑了。
zhaojun.why: Zhaojun's marriage helped keep peace on the northern frontier for decades and became a lasting symbol of friendship between peoples.
zhaojun.why_zh: 昭君出塞使北方边境维持了几十年的和平，也成为民族友好的永久象征。

people.name: Wang Zhaojun
people.role: Palace lady, consort of the chanyu

story: After defeating Xiang Yu, Liu Bang first thought of making Luoyang his capital. The soldier Lou Jing and the adviser Zhang Liang argued that Guanzhong, protected by mountains and rivers, was a far safer base. Liu Bang agreed and chose a site near the old Qin capital, naming it Chang'an, 'lasting peace'.

His chancellor Xiao He rebuilt an old Qin palace as the Changle Palace and then built the huge Weiyang Palace. In 200 BCE, returning from the war with the Xiongnu, Liu Bang saw it and was angry at the cost. Xiao He replied that the emperor's home must be grand to show his majesty. The court moved in that year.
Chang'an's city walls were built under Emperor Hui from 194 to 190 BCE.
story_zh: 打败项羽后，刘邦起初想定都洛阳。戍卒娄敬和谋士张良劝他说，关中有山河之险，是更安全的根据地。刘邦采纳了这一意见，在秦都旧址附近建都，取名“长安”，意为长治久安。
丞相萧何先把秦朝的旧宫改建为长乐宫，接着又修建了规模宏大的未央宫。前200年，刘邦从对匈奴的战场回来，看到宫殿如此壮丽，责怪花费太大。萧何回答说，天子以天下为家，宫殿不壮丽就显不出威严。当年朝廷便迁了进去。
长安城墙则是汉惠帝时期从前194年到前190年修筑的。
changan-capital.why: Chang'an remained the capital of China for most of the next thousand years, under the Han, Sui and Tang.
changan-capital.why_zh: 此后一千年中的大部分时间里，长安一直是汉、隋、唐等王朝的都城。

quote.zh: 天子以四海为家，非壮丽无以重威。
quote.en: The Son of Heaven takes all within the four seas as his home; without grandeur there is nothing to give weight to his majesty.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Han Xin had won more battles for Liu Bang than anyone, conquering Wei, Zhao, Qi and finally trapping Xiang Yu at Gaixia. He was made King of Chu, but in 201 BCE Liu Bang, suspecting him, had him arrested and reduced him to Marquis of Huaiyin, living in Chang'an under watch.

In 197 BCE the general Chen Xi rebelled in the north, and Liu Bang went to fight him. A servant accused Han Xin of planning to join the revolt. In 196 BCE Empress Lü consulted the chancellor Xiao He, who had first recommended Han Xin. They announced false news of victory and asked all nobles to come and offer congratulations. When Han Xin arrived at the Changle Palace, he was seized and beheaded, and his family was wiped out.
Within the year the other great generals Peng Yue and Ying Bu were also destroyed.
story_zh: 韩信为刘邦打的胜仗最多，平定魏、赵、齐，最后又在垓下围困项羽。他被封为楚王，但前201年刘邦对他起了疑心，把他抓起来降为淮阴侯，留在长安受到监视。
前197年，陈豨在北方叛乱，刘邦亲自出征。有仆人告发韩信要与陈豨里应外合。前196年，吕后与当初推荐韩信的丞相萧何商量，谎称前线已经大胜，召列侯入宫祝贺。韩信一到长乐宫就被拿下斩首，并被夷灭三族。
同一年，另两位大将彭越、英布也先后被消灭。
han-xin-death.why: Han Xin's death showed how the new dynasty removed powerful founders, and it became a byword for the fate of loyal servants.
han-xin-death.why_zh: 韩信之死说明了新王朝如何清除功高震主的开国功臣，也成为“兔死狗烹”的代名词。

people.name: Han Xin
people.role: Marquis of Huaiyin, former King of Chu

quote.zh: 狡兔死，良狗亨；高鸟尽，良弓藏；敌国破，谋臣亡。
quote.en: When the cunning hare is dead, the good hound is boiled; when the high birds are gone, the good bow is put away; when enemy states are destroyed, the clever minister perishes.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Lü Zhi had married Liu Bang before his rise and shared his dangers in the civil war. When he died in 195 BCE, their son became Emperor Hui, but real power lay with his mother.

She took cruel revenge on Liu Bang's favourite, Consort Qi, and poisoned her son Liu Ruyi. After Emperor Hui died in 188 BCE, she ruled through two child emperors and issued edicts in her own name. Against Liu Bang's rule that only members of the Liu family could be kings, she made several of her own relatives kings.

Yet her government was calm and taxes were light, and the historian Sima Qian praised the peace of her years. When she died in 180 BCE, the generals Zhou Bo and Chen Ping wiped out the Lü clan and made Liu Bang's son Liu Heng emperor.
story_zh: 吕雉在刘邦发迹前就嫁给了他，楚汉战争中同他一起历经艰险。前195年刘邦去世，他们的儿子即位为汉惠帝，实权却掌握在母亲手中。
她残酷报复刘邦宠爱的戚夫人，毒死戚夫人之子刘如意。前188年惠帝去世后，她先后立两个幼帝，以自己的名义发号施令。刘邦生前立下“非刘氏而王者，天下共击之”的盟约，她却封了好几个吕氏亲属为王。
不过她执政期间朝政安定、赋税轻简，司马迁也称赞那些年天下太平。前180年吕后去世，大臣周勃、陈平诛灭吕氏家族，拥立刘邦之子刘恒为帝。
empress-lu.why: Her rule kept the young dynasty stable, but the Lü clan's fall reinforced the rule that the throne belonged to the Liu family.
empress-lu.why_zh: 吕后执政稳住了新生的汉朝，而诸吕的覆灭则进一步确立了皇位只属于刘氏的原则。

quote.zh: 高后女主称制，政不出房户，天下晏然。
quote.en: Empress Lü, a woman, ruled in the emperor's place; government never left the palace chambers, and the realm was at peace.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Emperor Wen, who came to the throne in 180 BCE, and his son Emperor Jing, who ruled until 141 BCE, followed a policy of letting the people rest after decades of war. Inspired by Daoist ideas of non-interference, they kept government light and spending low.

Emperor Wen wore plain clothes and refused to build a new terrace when told it would cost as much as ten families' fortunes. He cut the land tax and for some years remitted it entirely. In 167 BCE, moved by a girl named Tiying who offered herself as a slave to save her father from mutilation, he abolished punishments that cut off parts of the body. Emperor Jing fixed the land tax at one-thirtieth of the harvest.
By the start of Emperor Wu's reign the granaries were overflowing and the treasury was full.
story_zh: 前180年即位的汉文帝和他的儿子、在位至前141年的汉景帝，在多年战乱之后奉行与民休息的政策。他们受道家“无为而治”思想的影响，尽量少扰民、少花钱。
汉文帝穿着朴素，听说修一座露台要花掉十户中等人家的家产，便打消了念头。他减轻田租，有些年份甚至全部免除。前167年，少女缇萦上书愿意没身为官奴，替父亲赎免肉刑，汉文帝深受感动，下令废除肉刑。汉景帝则把田租定为三十税一。
到汉武帝即位时，国家粮仓堆满粮食，府库钱财充盈。
wen-jing.why: The wealth built up under Wen and Jing paid for Emperor Wu's wars and expansion.
wen-jing.why_zh: 文景时期积累的财富，为汉武帝的对外战争和开疆拓土提供了雄厚的物质基础。

people.name: Chunyu Tiying
people.role: Girl who petitioned to save her father

quote.zh: 京师之钱累巨万，贯朽而不可校。
quote.en: The coins in the capital piled up in the hundreds of millions; the strings rotted and they could no longer be counted.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Mawangdui, in the eastern suburbs of Changsha, holds the tombs of Li Cang, the chancellor of the Changsha kingdom and Marquis of Dai, his wife Xin Zhui and their son. A wooden tablet in the son's tomb gives the year 168 BCE. They were excavated between 1972 and 1974.

Sealed in charcoal and white clay, Xin Zhui's tomb was so airtight that her body was found with soft skin and flexible joints after more than two thousand years. Above her coffin lay a T-shaped silk painting showing heaven, earth and the underworld. Her tomb also held a robe of plain silk gauze weighing less than 50 grams.
The son's tomb held a library of silk books, including two copies of the Daodejing older than any known before, medical texts, star charts that record comets, and maps of the region.
story_zh: 马王堆位于长沙东郊，这里埋葬着长沙国丞相、轪侯利苍，他的妻子辛追和他们的儿子。儿子墓中的一块木牍记有前168年的纪年。三座墓于1972年至1974年间发掘。
辛追墓用木炭和白膏泥层层密封，严丝合缝，两千多年后她的遗体出土时皮肤仍有弹性，关节还能活动。棺上覆盖着一幅T形帛画，描绘了天上、人间和地下的景象。墓中还有一件重量不足五十克的素纱襌衣。
儿子的墓中出土了大批帛书，其中有两种比以往所知版本更早的《老子》抄本，还有医书、记录彗星形态的天文图以及当地的地图。
mawangdui.why: Mawangdui gives a vivid picture of the life, beliefs and knowledge of the early Han elite and preserves texts found nowhere else.
mawangdui.why_zh: 马王堆汉墓生动展现了西汉初年贵族的生活、信仰和学识，还保存了许多别处没有的典籍。

people.name: Xin Zhui
people.role: Lady Dai, wife of the Marquis of Dai

people.name: Li Cang
people.role: Marquis of Dai, chancellor of Changsha

story: Liu Bang had given large kingdoms in the east to his relatives. By Emperor Jing's time some had grown rich and dangerous, especially Wu, whose king Liu Pi profited from copper mines and sea salt. The minister Chao Cuo urged the emperor to cut their lands.

In 154 BCE, when Wu was ordered to give up territory, Liu Pi rose in revolt with six other kings. They claimed they only wanted to remove the evil minister Chao Cuo. Emperor Jing had Chao Cuo executed in his court robes at the East Market, but the rebels kept marching.

The general Zhou Yafu let the rebels wear themselves out besieging Suiyang, held by the emperor's brother the King of Liang. Meanwhile he cut their supply lines. The rebel army collapsed, Liu Pi was killed, and the revolt was over in three months.
story_zh: 刘邦把东部的大片土地分封给同姓子弟为王。到汉景帝时，一些诸侯国已十分富强，尤其是吴国，吴王刘濞靠开采铜矿、煮海为盐积累了巨大财富。大臣晁错建议削减诸侯的封地。
前154年，朝廷下令削夺吴国的郡县，刘濞联合另外六个诸侯王起兵，打出“诛晁错，清君侧”的旗号。汉景帝下令把晁错斩于东市，晁错被杀时还穿着朝服，但叛军并没有退兵。
太尉周亚夫让叛军在景帝之弟梁王坚守的睢阳城下消耗兵力，自己则派兵截断其粮道。叛军很快溃散，刘濞被杀，叛乱三个月即告平定。
seven-states.why: After the revolt the kingdoms lost their power to govern themselves, and the emperor's control over the whole country was secured.
seven-states.why_zh: 平叛之后，诸侯国失去了自治的权力，皇帝对全国的控制得以巩固。

story: Liu An, King of Huainan, was a grandson of Liu Bang and a lover of learning. At his court in Shouchun he gathered thousands of scholars and magicians. Together they wrote a large book on how the universe works and how a ruler should govern.

In 139 BCE Liu An presented the work, later called the Huainanzi, to his young nephew Emperor Wu. Its 21 chapters mix Daoist thought with ideas from Confucian, Legalist and yin-yang schools. It discusses astronomy, geography and the seasons, and contains the earliest complete list of the 24 solar terms used in the Chinese farming calendar. It also preserves myths such as Nüwa mending the sky.
Emperor Wu soon turned toward Confucianism. In 122 BCE Liu An was accused of plotting rebellion and killed himself.
story_zh: 淮南王刘安是刘邦之孙，酷爱学问。他在都城寿春招揽了数千名学者和方士，合力编写了一部论述宇宙运行和治国之道的大书。
前139年，刘安把这部后来称为《淮南子》的书献给年轻的侄子汉武帝。全书二十一篇，以道家思想为主，兼采儒、法、阴阳各家，内容涉及天文、地理和四时变化，其中有现存最早的完整二十四节气名称，还保存了女娲补天等神话。
汉武帝不久便转向独尊儒术。前122年，刘安被指控谋反，自杀身亡。
huainanzi.why: The Huainanzi was the last great statement of Daoist-based statecraft before Confucianism became the official teaching.
huainanzi.why_zh: 《淮南子》是儒学成为官方学说之前，以道家为本的治国思想最后一部集大成之作。

story: When Emperor Wu took the throne in 141 BCE, he summoned learned men to answer his questions about good government. The Confucian scholar Dong Zhongshu argued that the emperor should honour only Confucius and the Six Arts and stop supporting other schools. Heaven, he said, warns rulers through natural disasters when they govern badly.

In 136 BCE the emperor appointed official scholars, called boshi, for each of the Five Classics. In 124 BCE an Imperial Academy was founded in Chang'an where students studied the Classics with these scholars. Those who passed exams could become officials. The system of recommending 'filial and incorrupt' men for office also favoured Confucian learning.
In practice, Han government still used Legalist laws and methods, but it now spoke in a Confucian voice.
story_zh: 汉武帝于前141年即位后，召集各地学者，询问治国之道。儒家学者董仲舒主张只尊崇孔子和六艺之学，不再扶持其他学派；他还认为，君主施政失当时，上天会降下灾异予以警告。
前136年，汉武帝为五经分别设立博士。前124年又在长安设立太学，让学生跟随博士学习经典，考试合格者可以做官。“举孝廉”的选官制度也有利于读儒书的人。
实际上，汉朝的统治仍然沿用法家的法律和手段，但对外已经以儒家的面貌出现，后人称之为“外儒内法”。
confucian-orthodoxy.why: From this time Confucianism was China's official ideology and the main path into government for two thousand years.
confucian-orthodoxy.why_zh: 从此儒学成为中国的官方意识形态，两千年间一直是读书人入仕的主要途径。

quote.zh: 诸不在六艺之科孔子之术者，皆绝其道，勿使并进。
quote.en: All teachings not within the Six Arts and the doctrines of Confucius should be cut off and not allowed to advance alongside them.

story: By the 130s BCE the young Emperor Wu was tired of paying tribute to the Xiongnu. A merchant from the frontier town of Mayi, Nie Yi, proposed a trick. He would tell the Junchen Chanyu that he could kill Mayi's officials and hand the town and its wealth over to him.

In 133 BCE about 300,000 Han soldiers hid in the valleys near Mayi, under Han Anguo, Li Guang and Wang Hui. The chanyu came south with 100,000 horsemen. But he noticed animals grazing in the fields with no herders in sight and grew suspicious. He captured a Han frontier officer, who revealed the plan, and the Xiongnu turned back.
Wang Hui, who had proposed the plan and failed to attack the retreating Xiongnu, was arrested and killed himself.
story_zh: 到前130年代，年轻的汉武帝已不愿再向匈奴屈辱求和。边城马邑的商人聂壹献上一计：他假装要杀死马邑官吏，把整座城和财物献给军臣单于，引诱匈奴入塞。
前133年，韩安国、李广、王恢等人率约三十万汉军埋伏在马邑附近的山谷中。单于率十万骑兵南下，途中看到满山牲畜却不见放牧的人，起了疑心。他俘虏了一名汉朝边塞小吏，得知了伏兵的计划，随即撤兵。
献计的王恢因没有截击撤退的匈奴而获罪，在狱中自杀。
mayi.why: The failed ambush ended the heqin peace and began more than forty years of war between Han and the Xiongnu.
mayi.why_zh: 马邑之谋失败后，和亲政策宣告终结，汉匈之间开始了四十多年的战争。

people.name: Wang Hui
people.role: Han official who planned the ambush

story: The Hexi Corridor is a long strip of oases between the Qilian Mountains and the Gobi Desert, west of the Yellow River. In the 120s BCE it was held by the Xiongnu kings of Xiutu and Hunye, cutting Han off from Central Asia.

In the spring of 121 BCE, the 19-year-old Huo Qubing led 10,000 cavalry west across the Yanzhi Mountains and seized a golden statue used by the Xiutu king in worship. In the summer he struck again, deep into the Qilian Mountains, killing and capturing tens of thousands. That autumn, the Hunye king, fearing the chanyu's punishment for these defeats, killed the Xiutu king and surrendered to Han with some 40,000 followers.
Han later set up commanderies along the corridor, including Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang, and moved settlers there.
story_zh: 河西走廊是黄河以西、夹在祁连山与戈壁之间的一长串绿洲。前120年代，这里由匈奴的休屠王和浑邪王控制，挡住了汉朝通往中亚的道路。
前121年春，年仅十九岁的霍去病率一万骑兵西进，越过焉支山，缴获了休屠王祭天用的金人。同年夏天他再次出击，深入祁连山，斩杀和俘虏匈奴数万人。秋天，浑邪王害怕单于追究战败之罪，杀死休屠王，率四万多部众投降汉朝。
汉朝此后在河西陆续设立武威、张掖、酒泉、敦煌等郡，并迁徙百姓前往屯垦。
hexi-campaign.why: Taking Hexi split the Xiongnu from the Qiang peoples and opened the Silk Road through Gansu.
hexi-campaign.why_zh: 夺取河西切断了匈奴与羌人的联系，也打通了经甘肃西去的丝绸之路。

story: Emperor Wu's wars against the Xiongnu and his other projects emptied the treasury that Wen and Jing had filled. Salt and iron were things every family needed, and private merchants had grown rich from them.

Around 119 BCE the emperor put the salt merchant Dongguo Xianyang and the iron master Kong Jin in charge of taking these trades over. Private production was banned, and the state set up salt and iron offices across the empire to make and sell them. The young official Sang Hongyang, a merchant's son with a gift for arithmetic, later ran the system and added new measures: the state bought goods where they were cheap and sold them where they were dear.
Merchants were also taxed heavily on their wealth and carts, and those who hid property could be reported for a reward.
story_zh: 汉武帝对匈奴连年用兵，加上大兴土木，把文景时期积攒的国库花得一干二净。盐和铁是家家户户的必需品，私人商人靠经营盐铁发了大财。
约前119年，汉武帝任用盐商东郭咸阳和冶铁商孔仅主持把盐铁收归官营。私人煮盐冶铁被禁止，朝廷在各地设立盐官、铁官负责生产和销售。精于算术的商人之子桑弘羊后来主管这一体系，又推行均输、平准等措施：由官府在物价低的地方收购货物，运到价高的地方出售。
朝廷还向商人的资产和车船征收重税，隐瞒财产的人一经告发，告发者可以得到奖赏。
salt-iron.why: The monopolies paid for Han expansion and began a long Chinese debate about how far the state should control the economy.
salt-iron.why_zh: 盐铁官营为汉朝开疆拓土提供了财源，也引发了中国历史上关于国家应在多大程度上掌控经济的长期争论。

story: In the early Han, coins were a mess. The government allowed private minting for a time, and many coins were light or mixed with lead and iron. Emperor Wu tried several new currencies, including white deer-skin notes and silver-tin coins, but forgers soon copied them.

In 118 BCE the court issued a new bronze coin, the wuzhu, named for its weight of five zhu, a little over three grams. It was round with a square hole and a raised rim that made it harder to clip. In 113 BCE all minting was given to three offices in the Shanglin park near Chang'an, and older coins were melted down.
The wuzhu was trusted and convenient. It stayed in use, with many local versions, until the Tang dynasty replaced it in 621 CE.
story_zh: 汉初的钱币十分混乱。朝廷一度允许私人铸钱，许多钱币分量不足，还掺了铅铁。汉武帝试行过白鹿皮币、银锡合金的白金币等多种新币，但很快就被人仿造。
前118年，朝廷发行一种新铜钱，因重五铢（三克多一点）而得名“五铢钱”。它外圆内方，边缘有凸起的外郭，使人难以从边上剪下铜屑。前113年，铸币权全部收归长安附近上林苑的三个官署，旧钱一律回收熔毁。
五铢钱分量可靠、使用方便，此后历朝虽有各种版本，却一直流通到唐朝武德四年（621年）才被开元通宝取代。
wuzhu.why: The wuzhu became the longest-used coin in Chinese history and a model for East Asian coinage.
wuzhu.why_zh: 五铢钱是中国历史上使用时间最长的钱币，也是东亚钱币的范本。

story: Gojoseon, in northern Korea and southern Manchuria, had been ruled since about 194 BCE by Wiman, a refugee from Yan, and his descendants. His grandson King Ugeo took in Chinese deserters and blocked other Korean states from sending envoys to Han.

In 109 BCE a Han envoy, She He, killed a Joseon official who was escorting him home, and was then killed in revenge. Emperor Wu sent two armies: Yang Pu by sea from Shandong and Xun Zhi by land from Liaodong. Both suffered early defeats, and the siege of the capital Wanggeom, near modern Pyongyang, dragged on.
In 108 BCE ministers inside the city killed King Ugeo and surrendered. Han set up four commanderies: Lelang, Zhenfan, Lintun and Xuantu. The two quarrelling Han generals were punished.
story_zh: 卫氏朝鲜位于朝鲜半岛北部和辽东一带，约前194年起由燕国流亡者卫满及其后代统治。他的孙子卫右渠收容汉朝逃亡者，还阻止半岛上其他国家派使者通汉。
前109年，汉朝使者涉何杀死护送他回国的朝鲜官员，随后遭到报复被杀。汉武帝派出两路大军：杨仆从山东渡海，荀彘从辽东走陆路。两军初战都失利，对都城王险城（今平壤附近）的围攻久攻不下。
前108年，城中大臣杀死卫右渠，开城投降。汉朝设立乐浪、真番、临屯、玄菟四郡。两位不和的汉军将领事后都受到惩处。
gojoseon.why: The commanderies, especially Lelang which lasted until 313 CE, brought Chinese writing, law and goods into the Korean peninsula.
gojoseon.why_zh: 汉四郡，尤其是存续到313年的乐浪郡，把汉字、法律和中原器物带入了朝鲜半岛。

story: Since Qin times the official calendar had started the year in the tenth month. Over a century it had drifted out of step with the sky, and eclipses and new moons came on the wrong days.

Sima Qian and other officials asked for reform. Emperor Wu called experts from across the empire, including the astronomer Luoxia Hong from Ba and Deng Ping. Luoxia Hong built an armillary sphere to measure the heavens. After comparing many proposals, the court adopted Deng Ping's system in 104 BCE, and the emperor renamed the era Taichu, 'Grand Beginning'.

The new calendar set the length of a month at 29 and 43/81 days. It started the year in the first month, as the Chinese New Year still does. It also fixed the rule that a leap month is added in a month with no major solar term.
story_zh: 自秦朝以来，官方历法一直以十月为岁首。一百多年下来，历法与天象逐渐脱节，日食、朔日常常对不上。
司马迁等人上书要求改历。汉武帝从各地召集历算专家，其中有来自巴郡的天文学家落下闳以及邓平等人。落下闳制造浑仪观测天象。朝廷比较了多种方案，前104年采用了邓平等人的历法，汉武帝改年号为“太初”。
新历法规定一个朔望月为29又81分之43日，以正月为岁首，今天的农历新年仍沿用这一规定。它还确立了以没有中气的月份为闰月的置闰规则。
taichu-calendar.why: The Taichu calendar fixed the basic shape of the Chinese lunisolar calendar for the next two thousand years.
taichu-calendar.why_zh: 太初历奠定了此后两千年中国农历的基本格局。

story: Zhang Qian had reported that Dayuan, in the Ferghana Valley, had splendid horses that seemed to sweat blood. Emperor Wu, who needed better horses to fight the Xiongnu, called them 'heavenly horses'. When Dayuan refused to sell them and killed his envoys, he decided on war.

In 104 BCE he sent Li Guangli, brother of his favourite Lady Li, with a large army. Short of food in the desert and attacked by the oases on the way, it failed, and only a fraction of the men returned to Dunhuang in 102 BCE. The emperor forbade them to come back through the Jade Gate and sent a second, much larger army.

This time Li Guangli besieged the Dayuan capital and cut off its water. In 101 BCE the nobles of Dayuan killed their king and handed over the horses: dozens of the best and about three thousand others.
story_zh: 张骞曾报告说，费尔干纳盆地的大宛国出产骏马，奔跑时汗出如血。汉武帝急需良马对付匈奴，把这种马称为“天马”。大宛拒绝出售，还杀了汉朝使者，汉武帝决定出兵。
前104年，他派宠妃李夫人的哥哥李广利率大军远征。大军穿越沙漠，粮草不继，沿途绿洲小国又闭城不供，远征失败，前102年退回敦煌时只剩下一小部分人。汉武帝下令不许他们进入玉门关，又派出规模大得多的第二支远征军。
这一次李广利围攻大宛都城，切断城中水源。前101年，大宛贵族杀死国王，献出良马：上等马几十匹，中等以下的马三千余匹。
heavenly-horses.why: The war showed Han power reaching deep into Central Asia and made the oasis states respect the Han.
heavenly-horses.why_zh: 这场战争显示汉朝的力量已深入中亚，使西域诸国对汉朝心存敬畏。

story: In his old age Emperor Wu was often ill and feared that people were using black magic against him. The official Jiang Chong, who disliked Crown Prince Liu Ju, led investigations and had many people executed for burying cursed wooden dolls. In 91 BCE he claimed to have found such dolls in the crown prince's palace.

The emperor was at his summer palace at Ganquan, and Liu Ju could not reach him to explain. Afraid of being killed, he seized Jiang Chong and executed him, then raised troops in Chang'an. Government forces fought the prince's men in the streets for five days, and tens of thousands died.
Liu Ju fled and hanged himself when he was found. His mother, Empress Wei Zifu, also killed herself. Later the emperor realized his son had been innocent and built a palace in his memory.
story_zh: 汉武帝晚年多病，疑心有人用巫术诅咒他。与太子刘据有嫌隙的江充奉命追查“巫蛊”，以埋木偶诅咒的罪名处死了许多人。前91年，他声称在太子宫中挖出了这样的木偶。
当时汉武帝在甘泉宫避暑，刘据无法当面辩白。他害怕被杀，便抓住江充处死，随后在长安起兵。官军与太子的人马在城中激战五天，死者数以万计。
刘据兵败出逃，被人发现后自缢身亡，他的母亲卫皇后卫子夫也自杀。后来汉武帝明白太子是冤枉的，修建了“思子宫”来纪念他。
witchcraft-scandal.why: The scandal wiped out the heir and his family and pushed the aging emperor to change course toward peace in his last years.
witchcraft-scandal.why_zh: 巫蛊之祸使太子一家几乎覆灭，也促使年迈的汉武帝在晚年转向休养生息。

people.name: Jiang Chong
people.role: Official in charge of the investigation

story: After Emperor Wu died in 87 BCE, the regent Huo Guang wanted to review his costly policies. In 81 BCE more than sixty Confucian scholars, called the 'worthy and learned', were brought to Chang'an to debate the government's ministers, led by Sang Hongyang.

The scholars said the salt and iron monopolies made the state compete with the people for profit, that the tools made in state workshops were poor and expensive, and that the wars against the Xiongnu were a waste. Sang Hongyang replied that the monopolies paid for the defence of the frontier and kept rich merchants from growing too powerful.

The result was a small change: the liquor monopoly was abolished, but salt and iron stayed in state hands. Sang Hongyang was executed the next year in a political plot. The debate was later written up by Huan Kuan as the Discourses on Salt and Iron.
story_zh: 汉武帝于前87年去世后，辅政的霍光想重新审视他那些耗资巨大的政策。前81年，六十多名被称为“贤良文学”的儒生被召到长安，与以桑弘羊为首的朝廷大臣展开辩论。
儒生们说，盐铁官营是国家与民争利，官府作坊造的农具又差又贵，对匈奴的战争也劳民伤财。桑弘羊则反驳说，盐铁收入是保卫边疆的经费来源，还能防止富商大贾势力过大。
辩论的结果只是小有改动：酒类专卖被取消，盐铁仍归官营。第二年，桑弘羊卷入一场政变被处死。后来桓宽根据这次会议的记录整理成《盐铁论》。
salt-iron-debate.why: The debate is the earliest detailed record of a Chinese argument over state control of the economy, and its questions are still discussed.
salt-iron-debate.why_zh: 这场辩论是中国关于国家掌控经济问题最早的详细记录，其中的议题至今仍有人讨论。

people.name: Huan Kuan
people.role: Author of the Discourses on Salt and Iron

story: In 100 BCE Su Wu was sent to the Xiongnu as an envoy. While he was there, members of his party joined a plot against the chanyu, and the whole mission was arrested. The Xiongnu tried to make Su Wu surrender. He refused, even when he was put in a cellar without food and survived by eating snow and felt.

The chanyu sent him to the shores of Beihai, Lake Baikal, to herd rams, saying he could go home when they gave milk. For years he lived there alone, holding the envoy's staff of the Han emperor until its tassels fell off. His friend Li Ling, a Han general who had surrendered, visited him but could not persuade him to change sides.
After Han and the Xiongnu made peace, a Han envoy learned that Su Wu was alive. In 81 BCE, after nineteen years, he returned to Chang'an.
story_zh: 前100年，苏武奉命出使匈奴。其间使团中有人卷入谋害单于的阴谋，全体被扣押。匈奴逼苏武投降，他宁死不从，被关进地窖断绝饮食，靠吃雪和毡毛活了下来。
单于把他流放到北海（今贝加尔湖）边放牧公羊，说等公羊生了小羊才放他回去。苏武孤身一人在那里生活多年，始终手持汉朝使节的旄节，连节上的牦牛尾毛都掉光了。投降匈奴的老友李陵来看望他，也没能劝他改变主意。
汉匈和好后，汉朝使者得知苏武还活着。前81年，在匈奴滞留十九年之后，苏武终于回到长安。
su-wu.why: Su Wu became China's great symbol of loyalty and steadfastness in the face of hardship.
su-wu.why_zh: 苏武成为中国历史上忠贞不屈、坚守气节的伟大象征。

quote.zh: 杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落。
quote.en: He herded sheep holding the Han envoy's staff, keeping it with him waking and sleeping, until all its tassels had fallen off.

story: Huo Guang, half-brother of the general Huo Qubing, was named regent by the dying Emperor Wu in 87 BCE. For thirteen years he ran the government for the young Emperor Zhao. When Emperor Zhao died in 74 BCE without a son, Huo Guang chose Liu He, King of Changyi and a grandson of Emperor Wu, as the new emperor.

Just 27 days later Huo Guang, with the Empress Dowager's approval, deposed him. The charge listed 1,127 improper acts, such as feasting during mourning and handing out offices to his own followers. Liu He was sent home and later made Marquis of Haihun. His rich tomb, full of gold and coins, was excavated in Nanchang in the 2010s.
Huo Guang then enthroned Liu Bingyi, grandson of the late Crown Prince Liu Ju, who had grown up among commoners after his family was destroyed. He became Emperor Xuan.
story_zh: 霍光是名将霍去病的异母弟。前87年汉武帝临终前，任命他辅佐年幼的汉昭帝，他执掌朝政十三年。前74年昭帝去世，没有儿子，霍光选立汉武帝之孙、昌邑王刘贺为帝。
仅仅二十七天后，霍光就在太后的同意下废黜了刘贺，罗列了他一千一百二十七件过失，比如服丧期间饮酒作乐、随意给亲信封官。刘贺被遣回原地，后来封为海昏侯。他那座满是黄金和铜钱的大墓于本世纪一十年代在南昌发掘。
霍光随后拥立已故太子刘据的孙子刘病已。刘病已在家族遭难后流落民间长大，即位后就是汉宣帝。
huo-guang.why: Emperor Xuan, who knew ordinary people's lives, gave the Western Han a last period of good government.
huo-guang.why_zh: 了解民间疾苦的汉宣帝，为西汉带来了最后一段政治清明的时期。

people.name: Liu He
people.role: Deposed emperor, later Marquis of Haihun

story: After decades of Han attacks, the Xiongnu fell into civil war in the 50s BCE. At one point five rival chanyus claimed the throne. Two brothers emerged as the main contenders: Huhanye in the south and Zhizhi in the north.

Weaker than his brother, Huhanye decided to seek the protection of Han. In the first month of 51 BCE he came in person to the court of Emperor Xuan at the Ganquan Palace. The emperor received him with great honour, placing him above the imperial princes and allowing him not to state his personal name. He was given a gold seal, robes, money and grain, and his people were allowed to live near the frontier forts.
Zhizhi went west to Central Asia, and Huhanye later returned to the northern steppe as a Han ally.
story_zh: 经过汉朝几十年的打击，匈奴在前50年代陷入内战，一度有五个单于同时争位。最后形成两大势力：南边的呼韩邪单于和北边的郅支单于，二人是兄弟。
实力较弱的呼韩邪决定投靠汉朝。前51年正月，他亲自到甘泉宫朝见汉宣帝。汉宣帝以隆重的礼节接待他，让他位居诸侯王之上，朝见时只称臣而不称名，又赐给他金印、衣服、钱财和粮食，允许他的部众在边塞附近居住。
郅支单于此后西迁中亚，呼韩邪后来作为汉朝的盟友回到漠北草原。
huhanye.why: For the first time a Xiongnu ruler accepted Han overlordship, bringing decades of peace to the northern frontier.
huhanye.why_zh: 匈奴单于第一次向汉朝称臣，北方边境迎来了几十年的和平。

story: Zhizhi Chanyu, Huhanye's brother and rival, moved west after losing ground in Mongolia. He killed the Han envoy Gu Ji and settled in Kangju, near the Talas River in today's Kazakhstan. There he built a fortified city and attacked neighbouring peoples.

In 36 BCE Chen Tang, deputy to the Protector General Gan Yanshou, decided to strike. Without waiting for permission from Chang'an, he forged an imperial order to call up the Han garrison troops and soldiers from the oasis states, about 40,000 men in all. Gan Yanshou objected at first but was persuaded.

The army marched across the Tianshan and stormed Zhizhi's city, which had a double wooden palisade. Zhizhi was wounded and killed, and his head was sent to Chang'an. Chen Tang wrote to the emperor asking that it be displayed as a warning.
story_zh: 郅支单于是呼韩邪的兄长和对手，在漠北失势后向西迁徙。他杀了汉朝使者谷吉，在康居境内今哈萨克斯坦塔拉斯河附近定居，修筑城池，攻掠邻近部族。
前36年，西域副校尉陈汤决定出击。他不等长安批准，就假传圣旨，征调汉朝屯田士兵和西域各国兵马共约四万人。西域都护甘延寿起初反对，后来被他说服。
大军翻越天山，攻打郅支设有两重木栅的城池。郅支单于受伤被杀，首级被送往长安。陈汤上疏皇帝，请求把首级悬挂示众，以儆效尤。
zhizhi.why: The campaign ended Xiongnu resistance in the west and showed the long reach of Han power.
zhizhi.why_zh: 此战消灭了西方匈奴的残余抵抗，显示了汉朝势力的远大。

people.name: Chen Tang
people.role: Deputy Protector of the Western Regions

quote.en: Whoever offends mighty Han shall be put to death, however far away.

story: Han governments counted households every year in order to collect taxes and call up men for labour and the army. Each county reported to its commandery, and each commandery to the capital.

The figures for the second year of the Yuanshi era, 2 CE, under Emperor Ping, were copied into the geography treatise of the Book of Han. They list more than 12.2 million households and about 59.6 million people, broken down by commandery and kingdom.

The record shows that most people lived on the North China Plain and in the Wei River valley, while the south was still thinly settled. It is the oldest surviving census of China and one of the oldest in the world. A century and a half later the Eastern Han population was of a similar size.
story_zh: 汉朝每年都要统计户口，以便征收赋税、征调徭役和兵员。各县上报郡国，各郡国再上报朝廷。
汉平帝元始二年（公元2年）的统计数字被收录在《汉书·地理志》中，记载全国共有一千二百二十多万户、约五千九百六十万人，并按郡国逐一列出。
这份记录显示，当时大多数人口集中在华北平原和渭河流域，南方还相当稀少。这是中国现存最早的全国人口统计，也是世界上最古老的人口普查记录之一。一个半世纪后，东汉的人口规模也大致相当。
census-2ce.why: The census gives a rare exact picture of an ancient empire's people and shows that Han China was one of the most populous states in the world.
census-2ce.why_zh: 这次统计为古代帝国的人口提供了难得的精确数据，表明汉朝是当时世界上人口最多的国家之一。

story: Wang Mang belonged to the family of the Grand Empress Dowager Wang Zhengjun, whose relatives had dominated the court for decades. Known for his modesty and Confucian learning, he became regent in 1 BCE for the nine-year-old Emperor Ping.

When Emperor Ping died in 6 CE, still a teenager, Wang Mang chose a one-year-old boy of the Liu family, Liu Ying, as heir instead of an adult prince. Wang Mang then took the title of acting emperor, sitting on the throne and receiving officials as the ruler, while the child was called Ruzi, 'the infant'.
Some members of the Liu clan rose against him, but they were quickly defeated. Officials sent in more and more reports of good omens, and in 9 CE Wang Mang declared himself emperor of a new dynasty.
story_zh: 王莽出自太皇太后王政君的家族，王氏外戚把持朝政已有几十年。他以谦恭俭朴、精通儒学著称，前1年起辅佐九岁的汉平帝执政。
公元6年，十几岁的汉平帝去世。王莽没有选立成年的宗室，而是挑了一个年仅一岁的刘氏男孩刘婴作为继承人，称为“孺子”。王莽自己则称“摄皇帝”，坐上皇位，以君主的身份接受百官朝见。
刘氏宗室中有人起兵反对，很快就被镇压。官员们不断呈报各种祥瑞，到公元9年，王莽正式称帝，建立新朝。
wang-mang-regent.why: The regency was the last step in Wang Mang's rise and ended the Western Han in all but name.
wang-mang-regent.why_zh: 居摄是王莽登上帝位前的最后一步，西汉自此名存实亡。
